source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    regions = [[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if r not in divider_rows and c not in divider_cols]]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(regions[0])
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_cuts) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_cuts[ri] + 1, row_cuts[ri + 1]
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_cuts) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_cuts[ci] + 1, col_cuts[ci + 1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
